name: Baal-zephon
line: Baal-zephon was a place near the Gulf of Suez, opposite where the Israelites camped by the sea just before they crossed it.

moments.title: God sets the camp
moments.text: The LORD told Moses to have the Israelites turn back and camp by the sea, directly opposite Baal-zephon. He said Pharaoh would think they were boxed in, and that He would gain honor by means of Pharaoh and his army.

moments.title: Pharaoh catches up
moments.text: The Egyptians chased Israel and overtook them camped by the sea near Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon. The people were terrified, but Moses told them the LORD would fight for them.

moments.title: A stop on the journey
moments.text: The list of Israel's travels says they set out from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon, and camped near Migdol. Then they set out from Pi-hahiroth and crossed through the sea.
